brief:
An Israeli military vehicle overturned in the village of Misilyah in Jenin district, Eye on Palestine reported. The incident took place in the northern West Bank, an area where Israeli military operations have continued. No immediate information was available regarding the cause of the overturn or whether there were any injuries.

The village of Misilyah lies within Jenin district, where tensions have remained high. Israeli military presence in the area has been a persistent feature of the occupation.
